newsitem.title: USA: NorAm holders seeking cash pro-rated.
newsitem.headline: NorAm holders seeking cash pro-rated.

text.p: Houston Industries Inc said Friday the final proration factor for NorAm Energy Corp shareholders who elected to receive cash for their stock was 83.6975 percent.
Houston Industries said the payment date for the transaction is August 18.
Of the 149.7 million shares of NorAm common stock outstanding, holders of about 102.6 million shares elected to receive cash.
As provided by the merger agreement, the number of NorAm shares converted into cash is limited by tax considerations, and cash elections were oversubscribed, Houston Industries explained.

NorAm shareholders who elected Houston Industries common stock will receive stock, as will shareholders who did not make an election by the election deadline of 1700 EDT/2100 GMT August 5, the company said.
It said shareholders who elected cash will receive 83.6975 percent of the cash requested, and will receive the balance of their compensation in Houston Industries shares.
